shots.name: 01-the-gap
shots.caption: 05:12, someone calls in sick. Ten people on the standby list, one slot to fill.

shots.name: 02-withheld
shots.caption: The four capabilities the agent was never given — each with its own reason, on the front page.

shots.name: 03-cascade-running
shots.caption: One call in flight, ever. Ringing all twenty at once is how four people turn up for one shift.

shots.name: 04-the-stop
shots.caption: The fifth call says yes. The cascade stops, and four people below the line are never rung.

shots.name: 05-transcript
shots.caption: Every outcome opens the call behind it — the goal the agent was given, and what was said.

shots.name: 06-exhausted
shots.caption: When nobody can take it, it says so and stops. No looping, no widening the list, nobody rung twice.

shots.name: 07-held
shots.caption: A call nobody could read stops the cascade. It is not scored as a no — nobody further down the list is rung until a person says what it meant, by name.
